evidence: Clicking "New Resume" created a blank "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills fields.
Template tab offers Modern, Classic, Minimal presets. Selecting "Classic" immediately changed the Live Preview styling/layout and was saved with the resume (shown as "classic" tag on dashboard card).

Successfully entered and edited Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, Professional Summary, Work Experience (company/title/dates/description), Education (institution/degree/field/dates/GPA), and Skills. All fields accepted and displayed input correctly.

Sections tab allows reordering sections via up/down arrow buttons (moved Education above Experience) and renaming section headings (renamed "Work Experience" to "Career History"), both reflected in preview.

Live Preview panel is visible alongside the editor and reflects all edits (contact, summary, experience, education, skills, template, section order/titles) in real time. Show/Hide Preview toggle works correctly.

Card menu (Rename/Duplicate/Delete) on dashboard. "Duplicate" created "QA Test Engineer Resume (Copy)"; "Rename" opened a dialog and successfully renamed it to "QA Test Engineer Resume - Startup Application".

Created and maintained multiple distinct resume versions ("QA Test Engineer Resume" and its duplicate/rename "QA Test Engineer Resume - Startup Application") alongside 3 pre-existing sample resumes, all listed and manageable on the dashboard.

Search box filters resumes by title in real time (searching "Marketing" showed only "Marketing Manager Resume"). Sort combobox offers Newest First, Oldest First, Title A-Z, Title Z-A; selecting Title A-Z correctly re-ordered the list alphabetically.

issue: Overlapping/conflicting time periods across different experience entries are not detected or prevented
actual: Added a second Work Experience entry with dates 2021-01 to 2021-06, which fully overlaps with the first entry's 2020-01 to 2022-06 range. The app accepted this without any warning, error, or conflict indication, and both entries were shown in the Live Preview simultaneously.

evidence: Date fields are native HTML "month" inputs (type=month). Attempting to type a non-conforming value ("invalid-date") into the field via Playwright raised a "Malformed value" error, confirming the browser/app enforces the correct YYYY-MM format and rejects invalid formats outright.

issue: Saved resumes are not persisted across a page reload
actual: After creating "QA Test Engineer Resume" and its duplicate "QA Test Engineer Resume - Startup Application" (both fully populated with data and visible in the dashboard list), reloading the page (navigating to http://localhost:7005/ again) caused both resumes to disappear entirely. Only the 3 original sample resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) remained, indicating data is held only in-memory/session state and not persisted to storage.

evidence: For all valid data entry across Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Template, and Sections tabs, the Live Preview updated immediately and accurately with no observed delay or rendering errors.

Moving "Education" above "Career History" (renamed from "Work Experience") via the up-arrow button and typing the new heading name both took effect immediately in the Live Preview with no lag or glitches.

issue: No user feedback (toast/notification/confirmation) is shown after saving actions
actual: Throughout resume creation, field edits, template switching, section reordering, renaming, and duplicating, the "Notifications" region on the page remained empty (no list items) at every observed snapshot. No success message, toast, or confirmation of any kind appeared to indicate a save had occurred.

evidence: Both the default (Modern) and Classic templates rendered all sections (Contact header, Summary, Education, Career History, Skills) completely in the Live Preview with proper headings, spacing, and formatting; no truncation, overlap, or missing content was observed.

After navigating away from the resume editor (back to dashboard) and reopening the resume, all entered fields (Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, section order, renamed heading, and template) were fully retained with no data loss.

Duplicated "QA Test Engineer Resume" and changed the Full Name field in the duplicate to "Jane Smith-Copy". Reopening the original resume confirmed it still showed "Jane Smith", unaffected by the change in the duplicate, proving independent data storage per version.

The resume title ("QA Test Engineer Resume", later "QA Test Engineer Resume - Startup Application") was consistently displayed identically on the dashboard card heading and in the resume editor's header title across all views.
